description: One room with ten takeable notes and one filed (storeIn) page, for checking the Notepad Previous/Next row, counter and search. Also two unlocked safes (seven notes and a key card; one note) for the note-returns-to-container proof.
test_objective: Verify the Notepad counter reads Note i of n, search reads Match i of n, and a filed page is not added to the Notepad
